facebook.caption:
POV: you wander into the Sorrento strip and spot a 4.9-star restaurant with 343 reviews nobody in your group has heard of.

Roma Restaurant & Coffee sits at 312-316 Sorrento, T.Trấn Hoàng Hôn, and the numbers don't lie. $15-30 a head. Nearly perfect rating. Consistently packed with people who found it the same way you did: by accident.

Book it before your whole resort catches on. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
